limitations: These are bounded component checks, not complete source correspondence or overall backend acceptance.
Focused acceptance listed here is JIT only; NativeAOT is available in the naming verifier but was not requested for these runs.
Source-typed enum signatures/locals/fields remain pending; current enum declarations use physical integral storage types.
Complex C++ decoded context can fall back to basename plus deterministic suffix; decoded text never controls identity or ABI.
